title: Width of the truth-table CNF
statement: Let $r\ge 0$ and let $f:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$. The maximum width of the clauses in the truth-table CNF formed from the assignments on which $f$ equals $+1$ is at most $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors of length $r$ to signs
